champion.description: You played a vital role in bringing peace to the continent. Recognition did not always carry your name, but {{pilotName}} fulfilled the mission to the end.
champion.name: Champion

falsePromise.description: {{pilotName}} arrived with potential, but perhaps this life was not for you.
falsePromise.name: False promise

livingLegend.description: Every enemy feared you. {{pilotName}} dominated every part of the battlefield.
livingLegend.name: Living legend

martyr.description: The nation mourned your death. {{pilotName}} became another reason to end the war.
martyr.name: Martyr of the nation

nationAce.description: No one doubts your decisions. Cadets enlist to fight beside {{pilotName}}.
nationAce.name: Ace of the nation

nationIdol.description: Everyone knows your name. People will tell stories about {{pilotName}} for generations.
nationIdol.name: Idol of the nation

puppeteer.description: Your only loyalty was to yourself. {{pilotName}} pulled the strings that decided the course of the war.
puppeteer.name: Puppeteer

solidPilot.description: You fought to the end and survived to see defeat. Even in the fall, {{pilotName}} learned what war demands from a soldier.
solidPilot.name: Solid pilot

spearOfZi.description: Your victories changed the course of the war. {{pilotName}} forgot the meaning of defeat.
spearOfZi.name: Spear of Zi

veteran.description: You served your nation for decades and retired on your terms. {{pilotName}} knew that a good soldier also knows when to stop.
veteran.name: War veteran

villageHero.description: You served, survived, and earned a reputation among your people. History might not remember {{pilotName}}, but you lived on your terms.
villageHero.name: Village hero

voiceOfCommand.description: You reached the top of the chain of command and proved your worth. {{pilotName}} earned the respect of an entire nation.
voiceOfCommand.name: Voice of command

warHero.description: Few pilots can face you. The enemy retreats when it hears the name {{pilotName}}. You decide the course of battle.
warHero.name: War hero
